mapper.select: SELECT id, is_in_progress, name, start_date, end_date, daily_hours, lesson_start_time, lesson_end_time, lunch_start_time, lunch_end_time, break_time, total_hours FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id, c.is_in_progress, c.name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.daily_hours, c.lesson_start_time, c.lesson_end_time, c.lunch_start_time, c.lunch_end_time, c.break_time, c.total_hours FROM course c JOIN learner_enrollment le ON c.id = le.course_id WHERE le.id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND le.deleted_at IS NULL
